response.text: {"issues":["Services intro and contact intro describe visitors in the third person (\"Stranke se prej najavijo …\"), which breaks the voice rule.","The phone-announcement note appears twice, in the services intro and in the contact section.","The about text says \"Z direktorico delata še dve računovodkinji\", which reads as third person and awkwardly names the staff."],"patches":[{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/2/props/intro","value":"Dokumente nam lahko pošljete po e-pošti ali jih prinesete osebno."},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/3/props/paragraphs/1","value":"Poleg direktorice sta pri nas zaposleni še dve računovodkinji."},{"op":"replace","path":"/pages/0/sections/4/props/intro","value":"Pokličite nas in se dogovorimo za obisk."}]}
